function pair<T, U = T>(first: T, second: U): U { return second; }
function fallback<T, U = T[]>(value: T, other?: U): T | U { return other ?? value; }
class DefaultPair<T, U = T> { constructor(public first: T, public second: U) {} }
console.log(pair<number>(1, 2), pair(1, "other"));
console.log(fallback(1), fallback<number>(1, [2]));
console.log(new DefaultPair<number>(1, 2));
